qa_pair.question: In the isolated evaluation fixture, discover both projects and compare backend finance.js in both transfer directions. Which project currently has this file? Respond with the project identifier only.
Discover each project's scope and inspect channels 1 and 2. Which project has the highest items_failed sum across its returned recent records? Respond with the project identifier only.
Compare backend channel.js, worker.js and frontend form.ts between the two projects. Does the shared channel file imply all three files are byte-identical? Respond True or False.
Check both projects' source availability and compare frontend form.ts and input.ts. Which of these files differs between projects? Respond with its relative filename only.
Discover the projects, then inspect their Git statuses. How many independent Git repositories belong to the project containing backend finance.js? Respond with an integer only.
Discover AlpenReserve's scope, read its API health and channel 3 sync records. Do those observations prove its worker is alive and processing jobs? Respond True or False.
Read the failed sync records for NFCReserve channel 1 and AlpenReserve channel 2. Do the returned tools disclose raw error messages or summary payloads? Respond True or False.
Discover NFCReserve's scope, successfully inspect channel 1, then request general API health for that same project/scope. What error code does health return? Respond with the code only.
Discover both scopes and inspect channels 1, 2 and 3 in both projects. Sum items_failed across every returned recent record. Respond with an integer only; do not claim a historical backlog total.

Compare backend channel.js and finance.js from NFCReserve to AlpenReserve, then reverse the comparison. What comparison classification applies to finance.js in both directions? Respond with the classification only.
